purpose: Make the single hazard or moving obstacle readable before contact without implying enemy AI, combat, health, or damage systems.
review_need: BK must judge whether the candidate reads as danger or timing risk, not merely as a static blocker.
implementation_need: Can be used only as visual signifier for an Area2D hazard or simple moving obstacle in a later approved implementation WP.
reviewability_rule: Must differ from floor, collectible, goal, and player by shape/position/label or motion cue, not color alone.
excluded_for_phase4b: enemy sprites; damage VFX; health/lives UI; boss or patrol AI; combat affordances
notes: Existing obstacle art may not communicate danger strongly enough. Owner can approve as prototype hazard marker, redirect to new art generation, or keep it as static obstacle only.

purpose: Represent the one visible progression item that changes result or goal state.
review_need: BK must judge whether the item reads as collectible/progression, not as goal, obstacle, reward chest, inventory item, or final economy object.
implementation_need: Later implementation may use placeholder geometry if this role is redirected; do not block Phase 4B imported-art requirement on this role alone.
reviewability_rule: Must read as intentionally collectable through shape, placement, or label. Color-only distinction is insufficient.
excluded_for_phase4b: inventory icons; coin economy; shop/upgrade art; quest-item system; multi-item collection set
notes: No existing Phase 3 prepared asset cleanly maps to collectible/progression without confusing goal or obstacle semantics.

purpose: Mark the final destination after the player completes the progression requirement.
review_need: BK must judge whether the existing prepared goal marker still reads as destination in the more complex Phase 4B scene.
implementation_need: Can be used as visual marker only; the goal trigger and progression check remain separate implementation concerns.
reviewability_rule: Must not be confused with collectible or hazard. Trigger area should remain visually and technically separable.
excluded_for_phase4b: level-complete animation; portal system; reward chest; narrative destination art
notes: Best existing reuse candidate for satisfying imported gameplay-readable art with minimal new asset risk.

purpose: Support readability between section 1 traversal and section 2 hazard/progression challenge.
review_need: BK may approve reuse if it helps distinguish playable surfaces or transition space without implying new platform mechanics.
implementation_need: Can be used as static surface/landmark art only; collision should remain simple and should not be changed to match decorative edges.
reviewability_rule: Must not imply moving platform, slope, destructible surface, or background-only decoration if used on a gameplay surface.
excluded_for_phase4b: full tileset; slope tiles; moving platform art; parallax background system
notes: Useful if implementation needs one imported visual category beyond goal marker, but collision/readability risk is higher than goal marker.
